name: Minnesota
dueDateNotes: Minnesota follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: Minnesota starts from your federal adjusted gross income and applies its four-bracket schedule after Minnesota's standard deduction ($15,300 single / $30,600 joint for 2026).
uniqueFacts: Minnesota adjusts its tax brackets and standard deduction for inflation every year; the 2026 brackets rose about 2.4% over 2025.
Minnesota has no county or city income tax, so the state rate is the only income tax you owe.
Minnesota requires estimated payments once you expect to owe $500 or more in state tax, a lower trigger than many states.
